chars.R: RANIA: a 19-year-old young woman wearing a mustard yellow knit cardigan over a white top, light blue jeans, a small brown shoulder bag.
chars.D: DOCTOR: a tall 28-year-old man wearing a light blue hospital scrubs top under an open navy blue blazer, dark grey trousers, a silver wristwatch.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a luxury black car at night, parked on a street of Rabat, Morocco, seen through the windshield from the front: the DOCTOR in the driver seat turns toward RANIA in the passenger seat with a curious, suspicious frown, one hand on the steering wheel; RANIA looks back at him nervously, hands on her bag. Warm street lights and palm trees outside.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night: RANIA in the passenger seat smiles relaxed and carefree, looking out the window at the lights of Rabat avenue, completely unaware of any problem.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night: the DOCTOR leans toward RANIA, one eyebrow raised, pointing at her phone in her hands with a questioning, testing look; RANIA blinks, surprised by the question.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Flashback: RANIA lying on her bed in her small bedroom in a Moroccan family apartment at night, scrolling her phone with a puzzled curious face, lit by the screen.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night: RANIA proudly and innocently nods with a big happy smile, holding up her phone, while the DOCTOR stares at her, frozen.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night, close on the DOCTOR in the driver seat: he is shocked, his white face gone pale and stiff, eyes wide, both hands gripping the steering wheel, a drop of sweat on his head.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night, seen from the back seat: awkward heavy silence, the DOCTOR stares straight ahead stone-faced, RANIA glances sideways at him, confused and uncomfortable, fidgeting with her bag strap.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night: the DOCTOR shakes his head slowly with a disappointed sigh, rubbing his forehead; RANIA turns to him with open hands, totally lost, not understanding what she did wrong.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Inside the luxury car at night: the DOCTOR turns to RANIA with a stern, accusing look, palm raised as if asking an explanation; RANIA presses back in her seat, shocked, mouth open, holding her phone to her chest.
